The rebrand includes a new logo, updated packaging, a redesigned website, and digital content intended to foster authentic conversations among men about grooming and self-expression.

title: Omnicom expresses confidence in face of Ukraine war, inflation
summary: Omnicom Group reported robust organic revenue growth of 11.9% year-on-year in Q1 2022, despite impacts from the war in Ukraine, its exit from Russia, and ongoing inflationary pressures. The advertising holding company raised its full-year organic revenue growth forecast to 6-6.5%, indicating confidence in its performance across various segments including advertising, precision marketing, and experiential marketing. Executives noted that clients have maintained spending plans, with inflation not yet affecting short-term media budgeting.

title: P&G Appoints Jon R. Moeller Chairman of the Board
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) has announced the appointment of Jon R. Moeller as chairman of the board, effective July 1, 2022. He will continue in his roles as president and chief executive officer, succeeding David Taylor, who is retiring. Joseph Jimenez has also been reappointed as Lead Director of the Board.

title: Coca-Cola turns to refillable glass bottles in fight against inflation
summary: Coca-Cola is expanding the use of more affordable, refillable glass bottles in markets severely affected by inflation, as the company anticipates a potential slowdown in consumer demand despite current strong sales. CEO James Quincey expects consumer "elasticity" to increase, signaling an eventual weakening of demand in response to continued price hikes. The company reported a 16% rise in net revenue in the first quarter, but also noted that suspending operations in Russia would impact its annual profit and net revenue.

title: How LV Vaidyanathan, the Satya Nadella fan, is looking to rewrite P&G India's fortunes
summary: LV Vaidyanathan, a P&G veteran and IIM-Ahmedabad alumnus, is set to take over as P&G India's head from July 1, 2022. He aims to transform the company's operations in India to capitalize on the country's strong growth prospects in the FMCG market. Inspired by Satya Nadella, Vaidyanathan plans to change the company's culture and image, focusing on product superiority, innovation, and sustainability.

title: Analytics Unite 2022: Procter & Gamble's David Dittman Joins Loyalty Talk
summary: David Dittman, vice president and chief analytics officer at Procter & Gamble, will join the "Innovative Loyalty: Identify the Data that Creates Obsessed Consumers" session at Analytics Unite 2022. The event will focus on creating impactful loyalty strategies that strengthen existing consumer relationships and incentivize new customers. Dittman will share insights from his 12+ years of experience at P&G in leveraging analytics for marketing, product supply, and customer business development.

title: P&G makes the case for its premium products as consumer budgets battle shrinkflation and rising prices
summary: Procter & Gamble is emphasizing the value of its premium products amid high inflation and rising prices, countering consumer trends toward private-label brands. The company's CFO, Andre Schulten, highlighted their "superiority strategy" as a driver of strong market and share growth. This approach aims to convince consumers that the performance and quality of brands like Tide justify their cost, even as budgets are squeezed.

title: Reckitt Joins Unilever and P&G in Strong Sales Driven by Pricing Hikes
summary: Reckitt Benckiser reported strong first-quarter sales, beating analyst estimates with 5.6% comparable sales growth due to price increases. The company is raising prices to counteract rising supply chain costs, similar to Unilever and P&G, and now expects full-year sales at the upper end of its guidance and profitability in line with the previous year.

title: Procter & Gamble Co: Greater Disclosure of Material Corporate Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Data
summary: Shareholders are requesting that Procter & Gamble ("P&G") disclose quantitative data on workforce composition, recruitment, retention, and promotion rates by gender, race, and ethnicity to assess the effectiveness of the company's diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts. The resolution highlights how P&G is lagging behind its S&P100 peers in sharing such data, which is crucial for investors to evaluate human capital management and avoid the perception of performative DEI practices. P&G's Chief Brand Officer, Marc Pritchard, has acknowledged the importance of DEI to consumers and the potential for significant financial gain from multicultural consumers, further underscoring the need for robust internal data.

title: David Taylor retiring from P&G; new chair named
summary: Procter & Gamble Executive Chairman David Taylor is retiring from his role after a four-decade career with the company, effective June 30. Jon Moeller is slated to replace him as chairman of the board. This move marks the end of Taylor's significant tenure and the transition of leadership at the Cincinnati-based consumer goods giant.

title: SEC concludes probe on PureCycle Technologies
summary: The SEC has concluded its investigation into PureCycle Technologies Inc. CEO Mike Otworth regarding statements about the company's technology, financial projections, and business plans, without taking further action. PureCycle, a plastics recycler specializing in polypropylene purification, stated its satisfaction with the outcome and reaffirmed its focus on company goals. This conclusion follows a previous subpoena to Otworth and questions raised by Hindenburg Research.

title: Fluff Pulp Market Faces Year of Transition
summary: The global fluff pulp market is experiencing a significant transition year, marked by record price levels in early 2022 and projected volumetric growth. A Smithers study predicts demand reaching 8.1 million air dried tons by 2027, driven by hygiene products, but facing challenges from evolving product designs and capacity constraints. The market is also seeing increased focus on sustainability, with fluff pulp being a key raw material for fiber-based nonwovens.

title: Makers of Dawn dish soap, Heinz ketchup, Clorox boost defenses against store brand rivals
summary: Brand-name product manufacturers like Clorox, Kraft-Heinz, and Procter & Gamble are increasing their defenses against store-brand rivals as consumers' budgets strain under persistent inflation. Companies are using tactics such as increased promotions, emphasizing product value, and launching innovative new products to maintain market share. This comes as Nielsen data shows that price hikes on private-label household goods have outpaced major brands, and consumers are increasingly opting for cheaper alternatives.

title: Newell Brands Promotes Chris Peterson to President
summary: Newell Brands announced the promotion of Chris Peterson to President & Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Peterson will continue to oversee financial operations, supply chain, procurement, IT, real estate, and global business services. CEO Ravi Saligram highlighted Peterson's contributions to complexity reduction, operational excellence, and strengthening the company's balance sheet since joining in 2018.

title: Heroes and Zeros: Eastman Chemical vs. Keurig
summary: This article contrasts Eastman Chemical's initiative to tackle single-use plastic waste with Keurig's misleading claims about the recyclability of its K-Cup pods. Eastman Chemical is investing in a $1 billion plant in France to convert plastic waste into new materials, while Keurig faced a $3 million penalty from Canada's Competition Bureau for greenwashing. The piece highlights the ongoing battle against plastic pollution and the need for genuine solutions versus deceptive marketing.

title: Newell Brands Names Chris Peterson President & CFO
summary: Newell Brands Inc. has appointed Chris Peterson as President & Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Peterson will continue to oversee financial operations, supply chain, IT, and related services, reporting to CEO Ravi Saligram. This promotion recognizes his significant contributions to the company's financial turnaround, operational excellence, and balance sheet strengthening since joining in 2018.

title: Newell Brands Appoints President And CFO
summary: Newell Brands Inc. has appointed Chris Peterson as President and Chief Financial Officer, acknowledging his significant contributions to the company's turnaround and operational excellence. Peterson will continue to oversee financial operations, supply chain, IT, and real estate, reporting directly to CEO Ravi Saligram. This promotion recognizes his efforts in improving the company's balance sheet, reducing complexity, and driving profitable growth.

title: Edgewell Q2 net sales grow 5.5%, but Wilkinson Sword owner adjusts outlook for fiscal 2022
summary: Edgewell Personal Care reported a 5.5% increase in net sales for Q2 2022, reaching $547.7 million, with strong performance in sun care, grooming, and women’s shave categories. Despite this growth, the company adjusted its full-year earnings per share outlook downwards due to projected increases in commodity and transportation-related cost inflation. Supply chain disruptions are largely resolved, but cost headwinds are expected to persist, impacting the profitability of its wet shave business, though sun and skin care performed better.

title: Procter & Gamble announces new commitments and shares progress on actions to strengthen Equality & Inclusion across Asia Pacific, the Middle-East, and Africa - PR Newswire APAC
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) announced new commitments at its fourth annual #WeSeeEqual summit for Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa, aiming to advance Equality & Inclusion. These commitments include investing $300 million with women-owned businesses, achieving equal representation of female directors in advertising by

title: Rising fats and oil prices have Colgate-Palmolive looking to mitigate costs
summary: Colgate-Palmolive is facing "greater-than-expected" increases in raw material costs, particularly fats and oils, which have doubled since 2020 and are projected to rise an additional 60% year-over-year. The company is exploring mitigation tactics such as leveraging alternate materials and reformulating products to combat these rising costs, further exacerbated by the war in Ukraine and an Indonesian palm oil export ban.

title: Procter & Gamble announces new DEI commitments and shares actions to strengthen equality & inclusion across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) has unveiled new commitments to advance Equality & Inclusion across Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa at its fourth annual #WeSeeEqual summit. These commitments include investing US$300 million with women-owned and women-led businesses by 2025, achieving equal representation of female directors in brand advertisements by 2024, and improving advertising accessibility for people with sight and hearing impairments by 2024. P&G is also introducing a 'ReLaunch program' to support professionals returning to STEM roles after a career break, all aimed at fostering a more equitable and inclusive environment.

title: New P&G distribution center will bring 350 new jobs to Butts County
summary: Procter & Gamble Distributing, LLC is investing $205 million in a new distribution facility in Jackson, Georgia, which is expected to create 350 new jobs in Butts County. Governor Brian Kemp announced the company's expansion, highlighting the focus on creating jobs in rural Georgia. The distribution center will be over 1 million square feet and will be a state-of-the-art, automated facility.

title: Marchoe Northern is returning to the U.S. fresh from global success
summary: Marchoe Northern of Procter & Gamble is returning to the U.S. after achieving global success. This article, published on May 16, 2022, highlights her return as part of Ad Age's "Leading Women 2022" series.

title: Procter & Gamble Stock Forecast and Price Prediction
summary: This article provides a stock forecast and price prediction for Procter & Gamble (NYSE: PG), including analyst targets for the remainder of 2022. It highlights P&G's strong return on assets and equity, expected revenue growth, and positive first-quarter earnings that beat expectations, leading to an updated sales forecast. The article also delves into key financial data points like P/E ratios, debt coverage, and profit margin.

title: Clorox Announces Appointment of Julia Denman and Stephanie Plaines to its Board of Directors
summary: The Clorox Company announced the appointment of Julia Denman and Stephanie Plaines to its board of directors, expanding the board to 13 members. Both Denman and Plaines bring extensive financial expertise and leadership experience from various sectors, enriching the board's diversity and qualifications. They are expected to serve on the audit committee, contributing to Clorox's strategic goals and stakeholder value.

title: Is Procter & Gamble a Climate and Rights Villain?
summary: The article accuses Procter & Gamble (P&G) of being a "climate and rights villain" due to its alleged involvement in deforestation, Indigenous land theft, and labor violations. It highlights P&G's continued sourcing from palm oil companies linked to destruction in crucial ecosystems like the Leuser Ecosystem and the use of forced labor, despite public and scientific consensus on environmental protection. The author urges consumers and investors to pressure P&G to stop sourcing from suppliers that destroy primary forests and protect communities.

title: Clorox sheds suppliers as COVID-19 inches toward 'endemic phase'
summary: Clorox is reducing its reliance on backup suppliers hired during the pandemic as COVID-19 transitions to an "endemic phase" and demand stabilizes. The company aims to consolidate its external manufacturer portfolio to strategic partners and boost in-house manufacturing capacity, expecting cost-reduction benefits in fiscal year 2023. Despite improvements in service levels and declining spot transportation rates, Clorox still faces material and labor shortages impacting raw material availability and is working with retailers and logistics partners to further enhance service.

title: Egypt, Procter & Gamble discuss expansion plans
summary: Egyptian Minister of Trade and Industry, Nevine Gamea, met with Samir Lebbar, regional CEO of Procter & Gamble International for Egypt and North Africa, to discuss the company's investment plans and expansion in the Egyptian market. Gamea praised P&G's new liquid detergent production line and emphasized the importance of expanding projects in Egyptian and African markets to foster economic cooperation. Lebbar reiterated P&G's commitment to local manufacturing, increasing Egyptian exports, and leveraging free trade agreements, highlighting their over 30 years of operation in Egypt with investments exceeding LE 3.5 billion and exports totaling $250 million annually.

title: The 5 JUST 100 Companies Leading on Gender Board Diversity
summary: Despite women leaving the workforce at a higher rate during the pandemic, board leadership has seen gains in gender diversity. This article identifies five JUST 100 companies—General Motors, Citigroup, Procter & Gamble, Nielsen, and Merck—that lead in board gender diversity with 40% or more women on their boards and at least one female-chaired committee. It details how each company prioritizes gender diversity and ESG performance within their leadership structures.

title: Procter & Gamble Co. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
summary: Procter & Gamble Co. (PG) stock saw a 1.78% increase, closing at $147.63 on Tuesday, outperforming several competitors despite a mixed trading session for the broader market. This marked the stock's third consecutive day of gains, bringing it closer to its 52-week high. The company's trading volume was slightly below its 50-day average.

title: Instagram, Google and P&G: Brands embrace inclusion
summary: As America's population becomes increasingly diverse, brands like Instagram, Google, and P&G are prioritizing inclusivity in their advertising and product development. This shift is driven by consumer demand, particularly from Gen Z and multicultural backgrounds, for relevant representation and social action. The article highlights successful strategies for marketers, including working with diverse media suppliers and internal teams, and ensuring transparent accountability in DEI initiatives.

title: Procter & Gamble is placing a big bet on the metaverse to support its suite of brands
summary: Procter & Gamble is dedicating significant resources to the metaverse to find new ways to interact with consumers and add value for them and retail partners. The company has used the metaverse to replicate industry events, launch virtual brand experiences including games, and promote sustainability efforts. While engagement has increased, P&G acknowledges the ultimate business value is still being determined, but sees it as a transformative platform for consumer engagement.

title: P&G Can’t Have Oral B Smart Toothbrush BIPA Class Action Moved Out of Illinois
summary: A judge has denied Procter & Gamble's request to move a class action lawsuit concerning its Oral-B "smart toothbrush" out of Illinois. The lawsuit alleges P&G illegally collected customers' facial geometry information, violating the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), without obtaining proper consent. The judge ruled that the lead plaintiff was not bound by the app's terms of service agreement, which stipulated cases be heard in Ohio, as there was no evidence he agreed to the terms.

title: Unilever Shares Jump as Peltz on Board Seen Spurring Change
summary: Unilever Plc's shares saw their largest gain in four months after the company appointed activist investor Nelson Peltz as a non-executive director. Peltz, whose Trian Fund Management holds a 1.5% stake in Unilever, is expected to drive changes within the consumer-goods giant. He will join the board and compensation committee in July, increasing pressure on current leadership.

title: Billionaire investor Nelson Peltz, with 1.5% stake, joins Unilever board
summary: Billionaire activist investor Nelson Peltz is joining the board of Unilever PLC, the consumer goods giant announced. Peltz's hedge fund, Trian, has acquired a 1.5% stake in Unilever, and he is expected to push for strategic changes after recent disappointing performance and an unsuccessful bid for GSK's consumer health care arm. Investors and analysts welcome his appointment, hoping he can revitalize the company's culture and financial results, similar to his past involvement with Procter & Gamble.

title: After P&G revamp, activist investor Peltz moves on to Unilever
summary: Activist investor Nelson Peltz will join the board of Unilever, prompting a 7% jump in shares as investors anticipate a strategic overhaul similar to his previous success with Procter & Gamble. Peltz's hedge fund Trian holds a 1.5% stake in Unilever, and he is expected to push for significant changes following the company's recent lackluster performance and an unsuccessful bid for GSK's consumer healthcare arm. His appointment is seen as an opportunity to revamp company culture and financial performance, particularly through his role on the compensation committee.

title: Inter Parfums, Inc.’s CFO Russell Greenberg to Retire After Over 30 Years of Service
summary: Russell Greenberg, the Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Inter Parfums, Inc., is set to retire on September 6 after over 30 years of service. He will be succeeded by Michel Atwood, previously the Vice President of Finance and Strategy at The Estee Lauder Companies. Greenberg will stay until September 30 to facilitate a smooth transition, and Atwood will also fill the board seat Greenberg vacates.

title: Puig Buys Byredo; DSM & Firmenich To Merge; The Honest Company’s New EVP-Operations and R&D
summary: This article highlights the top news in the beauty and personal care industry for the week ending June 4, 2022, as reported by Happi.com. Key stories include Puig's acquisition of a majority stake in luxury fragrance brand Byredo, the merger announcement between DSM and Firmenich, and The Honest Company appointing Steve Winchell as Executive Vice President, Operations and R&D. The piece ranks these and other significant company news, such as Procter & Gamble's expansion into health and wellness, and various executive appointments and product launches.

title: Procter & Gamble Gets New Legal Head as Longtime Chief to Retire
summary: Procter & Gamble Co. announced that Susan Street Whaley will succeed Deborah Majoras as chief legal officer and corporate secretary, effective July 1, 2022. Majoras, who has served for a dozen years, will retire on September 16, 2022. Whaley has been with P&G for over 23 years, most recently as general counsel for North America.

title: Street closed, protesters led away in handcuffs after rally outside P&G Tuesday
summary: A section of Broadway Street in downtown Cincinnati was closed due to a protest outside Procter & Gamble's headquarters. Four protesters were arrested after refusing to clear the street. The demonstrators were protesting P&G's alleged contributions to global deforestation and poor human rights practices, concerns which P&G stated they address through responsible sourcing.

title: This Dollar Store Battery Rivals Big-Name Brands
summary: A recent test revealed that E-Circuit alkaline AA batteries from Dollar Tree perform nearly as well and last almost as long as more expensive brand-name batteries, offering significant savings. The study, conducted by the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation’s “Marketplace” program and Ontario Tech University, found these dollar-store batteries provide excellent capacity per dollar, especially for low to high-drain devices. However, the study also cautioned against carbon zinc dollar-store batteries, which performed poorly across all devices.

title: Procter & Gamble’s CIO believes passion is contagious. His latest passion: digitally remaking the 185-year-old company
summary: Vittorio Cretella, CIO at Procter & Gamble, is leading a massive digital transformation of the 185-year-old company. P&G has partnered with Microsoft to leverage the Microsoft Cloud, aiming to accelerate its digital manufacturing platform and enrich the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). This collaboration seeks to improve productivity, speed up product delivery, boost customer satisfaction, and reduce costs, while also enhancing environmental sustainability through optimized energy and water consumption.

title: Battle of toothpaste brands in Nigerian market
summary: The Nigerian oral care market is a significant battleground for toothpaste brands due to the country's large population. While global oral care markets are growing, local retailers and consumers in Nigeria indicate that economic realities and price points heavily influence consumer choices and brand loyalty, even for widely used brands like Close-Up. This dynamic leads to a diverse market where various brands contend for market share based on formulation, packaging, and marketing strategies.

title: P&G Levels Up Manufacturing With Machine Learning and AI
summary: Procter & Gamble is partnering with Microsoft to implement AI, machine learning, and edge computing across over 100 manufacturing sites globally to improve productivity, reduce costs, and increase consumer satisfaction. This multiyear relationship will leverage Microsoft Azure to digitize and integrate data, enabling real-time, data-informed decisions and innovations in areas such as energy use, downtime reduction, and product quality. The collaboration includes the creation of a Digital Enablement Office to incubate and deploy high-priority business scenarios.

title: Edgewell Personal Care aims to appeal to modern explorers with Gen-Z brand Fieldtrip
summary: Edgewell Personal Care launched Fieldtrip, a new genderless skin-care brand targeting Gen Z, after research indicated a strong interest in gender-neutral products among young men. Operated by the Jack Black team, the brand emphasizes a "modern explorer" concept with globally sourced ingredients and aims for $4 million in retail sales in its first year. Fieldtrip is available at Nordstrom and via its DTC site, focusing on sustainability, travel, and a broad appeal to all skin types and genders.

title: P&G Unveils New Strategy to Help Address Global Water Crisis
summary: Procter & Gamble has announced a significant expansion of its Ambition 2030 sustainability efforts, introducing a new strategy to address the global water crisis. This includes a first-of-its-kind goal to restore more water than is consumed during the use of P&G products in the critically water-stressed metropolitan areas of Los Angeles and Mexico City. The strategy encompasses reducing water use in manufacturing, fostering innovation, and supporting water restoration projects in 18 water-stressed regions worldwide through partnerships.

title: P&G Announces a Water Positive Future Strategy: Our Vision to Reduce, Restore and Respond
summary: P&G has announced a comprehensive strategy for a "Water Positive Future" with the goal of restoring more water than it consumes in at-risk watersheds by 2030, including during consumer use of products in high water-stressed metropolitan areas. This initiative involves on-site water efficiency, long-term restoration projects in critical areas, and inspiring consumers to reduce their water footprint through product innovations and collective actions. The strategy is inspired by the legislative legacy of Virginie Helias's father, Jacques Oudin, who championed decentralized cooperation in water and sanitation.

title: Edgewell debuts Gen Z-focused skincare brand, Fieldtrip
summary: Edgewell has launched Fieldtrip, a new clean skincare brand aimed at Gen Z consumers. The brand offers unisex products with luxury formulations under $25, initially sold direct-to-consumer and on Amazon, with plans to expand to Nordstrom and Macy's. Fieldtrip emphasizes sustainability and affordability, aligning with Gen Z's values.

title: Ingredion names VP, chief procurement officer
summary: Javier Echevarria has been appointed as the new vice president and chief procurement officer at Ingredion, Inc. In this role, he will oversee global procurement, supply chain operations, and strategic sourcing, reporting to Eric Seip. Echevarria brings extensive experience from VVF Americas, Glanbia, Avient Corp., and Procter & Gamble.

title: Tampon manufacturers working to address reported shortages in U.S.
summary: Tampon manufacturers are working to address reported shortages across the United States. U.S. Senator Maggie Hassan has sent letters to major manufacturers like Procter & Gamble and Edgewell Personal Care, urging them to increase supply and combat price gouging. The shortage follows similar issues with baby formula and rising prices for essential goods.

title: P&G taps Microsoft for cloud services to boost production efficiency
summary: Procter & Gamble has partnered with Microsoft to utilize its Azure cloud computing services and predictive analytics to enhance manufacturing efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product delivery. This collaboration aims to leverage digital manufacturing visibility and advanced analytics to optimize production processes for various P&G products globally. The initiative builds on four years of prior cooperation, focusing on better data utilization, automation, digital twins, and sustainability.

title: Procter & Gamble Partners With Microsoft To Transform And Accelerate Digital Manufacturing
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) has partnered with Microsoft to advance digital manufacturing through cloud, AI, and digital transformation technologies. This multiyear collaboration aims to make manufacturing smarter by utilizing Microsoft Cloud, Azure data, and AI solutions to optimize P&G's manufacturing and packaging processes, initially focusing on diaper and paper towel production. The initiative seeks to improve predictive quality, reduce downtime, enhance supply chain efficiency, and explore the concept of an "industrial metaverse" for simulating manufacturing environments.

title: Procter & Gamble Accelerates Action to Widen the Screen by Building a Pipeline of Diverse Talent, Reaching Underrepresented Audiences and Driving Inclusive Growth in the Media Industry
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) is expanding its "Widen The Screen" initiative to create more opportunities for diverse filmmakers and promote inclusive representation in media. The program focuses on building a talent pipeline, investing in underrepresented media, and partnering with various communities to drive systemic change. Key efforts include expanding the Queen Collective for female directors of color, participating in the Cannes Creative Bootcamp, and supporting projects for LatinX, Asian-Pacific Islander, and LGBTQ+ communities.

title: Carrier and P&G Join Forces to Create Healthier Homes
summary: Carrier and Procter & Gamble's Home Care brands are collaborating to promote healthier homes through education, innovation, and integrated solutions for improved indoor air quality and safety. This partnership aims to empower consumers with insights and products to tackle common household health challenges like dust accumulation and carbon monoxide safety. The initiative is expected to expand, focusing on consumer needs and behaviors related to total home health.

title: P&G’s Marc Pritchard: ‘the industry has gone too far with purpose marketing’
summary: Marc Pritchard, chief brand officer at Procter & Gamble (P&G), suggests that some companies have over-leveraged purpose marketing to the detriment of brand growth, especially amidst inflation and the cost of living crisis. He argues that growth should be the primary focus for businesses, as it enables them to do good. Pritchard advises marketers to "double down" on product superiority and media spend, rather than cutting investment during economic pressures.

title: A closer look at P&G’s ‘water positive’ pledge
summary: Procter & Gamble has announced a "water positive" goal by 2030, aiming to restore more water than its operations and products consume. The initiative includes two new restoration pledges focusing on water consumed during manufacturing and by household product use in 18 water-stressed regions, primarily Los Angeles and Mexico City. P&G is investing in various restoration projects and integrating sustainability metrics into executive compensation, while experts commend the company's rigorous approach to consumer-use impact but call for more engagement with public policy for broader impact.

title: Ashland Appoints Steve Bishop and Suzan Harrison as Directors
summary: Ashland Global Holdings Inc. has appointed Steve D. Bishop, former CEO of Procter and Gamble consumer health care, and Suzan F. Harrison, former president of Colgate-Palmolive global oral care, to its board of directors effective July 1, 2022. These appointments will temporarily expand the board from nine to eleven members, succeeding William Dempsey and Ricky Sandler who will not seek re-election in January 2023. Guillermo Novo, Ashland's CEO, expressed confidence that the new directors will bring valuable perspectives to the company's strategy and profitability.

title: Explainer: Plastic sachets: As big brands cashed in, a waste crisis spiraled
summary: Plastic sachets, initially introduced by companies like Unilever to reach low-income customers in developing nations with affordable micro-portions of products, have led to a significant global pollution crisis. These multi-layered plastic and foil pouches are difficult to recycle due to their complex design and small size, contributing to environmental damage in countries often lacking proper waste management. Despite public commitments to address the issue, a Reuters investigation revealed Unilever has privately worked against bans on this packaging.

title: Is Procter & Gamble Co (PG) A Great Value Stock?
summary: This article examines Procter & Gamble Co (PG) as a potential value stock, highlighting its strong brand portfolio and consistent performance. It analyzes various financial metrics like Acquirer's Multiple, Expected Return, Return On Assets, Incremental Growth, FCF Yield, and Shareholder Yield to assess its valuation and intrinsic value. The analysis suggests that based on these metrics, PG could be considered a great value stock.

title: Who’s to blame for the tampon shortage? Depends on who you ask
summary: This article investigates the causes of the tampon shortage, highlighting that major manufacturers offer conflicting explanations. While some, like Kimberly Clark, deny a shortage, Procter & Gamble attributes it to costly raw materials. A supply chain expert argues the issue is P&G-specific due to their market dominance and poor planning, rather than an industry-wide problem, contrasting it with the baby formula shortage which was attributed to an oligopoly and plant closures.

title: In Venezuela, Foreign Companies Are in Survival Mode
summary: This article explores the challenging environment for foreign companies in Venezuela, highlighting how many have left, some are trying to sell assets, and a few have adapted to survive. It details the reasons for departures, including government seizures and economic instability, and examines survival strategies of those who stayed, such as adapting product lines and reducing staff. The piece also notes the gradual return of some international airlines and the overall uncertain future for foreign investment due to ongoing economic and legal challenges.

title: What's the Impact of the Strong Dollar on My Portfolio?
summary: The strong U.S. dollar, experiencing its biggest rally in 20 years, negatively impacts non-U.S. fund returns and profitability for American companies operating overseas. While it offers advantages for consumers traveling abroad, investors in international stocks and bonds face challenges due to unfavorable exchange rates and increased repayment costs for dollar-denominated debt. Despite the difficulties, some Morningstar analysts suggest currency hedging can minimize volatility, and others view the current currency weakness as an attractive buying opportunity for international funds.

title: Black Swan Data Closes $18.5 Million in Funding
summary: Black Swan Data, a London-based SaaS company specializing in predicting consumer behavior using social data, secured an $18.5 million growth investment. The funding round was led by Oxx, with participation from existing investors AlbionVC, Blackstone, Mitsui, and Lloyds. This investment will support the development of advanced features for its Trendscope platform and aid in its expansion into the US market.

title: Commercial Club of Cincinnati names first-ever woman president; Candace McGraw is secretary
summary: The Commercial Club of Cincinnati, the city’s oldest civic-business club, has announced its new officers and executive committee for the 2022-2023 term. Jill P. Meyer, CEO of Cincinnati USA Regional Chamber, was named President, becoming the first woman to hold the position since the club's founding in 1880. Candace McGraw, CEO of Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport, was appointed Secretary.

title: How a Disney and P&G Director Found Her Own Direction
summary: Amy Chang, a board member at Disney and P&G, overcame initial intimidation to navigate critical corporate challenges, including a major proxy fight at Procter & Gamble. She shares her experience of relying on trusted advisors for guidance on management decisions and moral dilemmas.

title: A new way iconic brands like Procter & Gamble, Nokia are cashing in on R&D moonshots
summary: Iconic brands like Procter & Gamble and Nokia are utilizing a new approach to monetize their R&D innovations through Innventure, a firm that builds startups around corporate technologies. This model allows parent companies to become key customers of the spun-out businesses, offering a less risky alternative to traditional venture capital. Notable examples include Accelsius, leveraging Nokia's cooling technology, and PureCycle Technologies and AeroFlexx, born from P&G's sustainability R&D.

title: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. stock falls Monday, still outperforms market
summary: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) saw its stock fall by 0.31% on Monday, closing at $116.22, despite the broader market experiencing a more significant downturn. This marked the third consecutive day of losses for IFF, which remains $40.86 below its 52-week high. The company's performance was mixed compared to competitors, with Procter & Gamble Co. seeing gains while L'Oreal S.A. ADR and Estee Lauder Cos. Cl A both declined.

title: Procter & Gamble to Launch Tide Laundry Detergent Research on SpaceX CRS-25
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) is launching an investigation on SpaceX's 25th Commercial Resupply Services (CRS) mission to evaluate the performance of its Tide to Go Pens and Tide to Go Wipes in the microgravity environment of the International Space Station (ISS) National Laboratory. This research builds upon previous work with Tide Infinity detergent, aiming to understand how fluids interact with woven fibers and improve stain removal efficacy in resource-constrained environments both in space and on Earth. The study will involve astronauts testing the products on common stains found on the orbiting laboratory, providing insights for more sustainable and effective cleaning solutions.

title: Black beauty brands and consumers: Where do we go from here?
summary: This article discusses the inequities Black beauty brands and consumers face within the beauty industry, focusing on findings from a new McKinsey report. Ulta Beauty CEO Dave Kimbell, alongside McKinsey senior partners Tiffany Burns and Kristi Weaver, highlights pain points for Black entrepreneurs and shoppers, including limited access to capital, product availability issues, and unknowledgeable store staff. They suggest actions like supporting small Black-owned businesses, increasing Black representation in the workforce, and making the in-store experience more welcoming to drive positive change and achieve greater racial equity.

title: P&G conference takeaways—the economy's not bad and TikTok's not social
summary: This article reports on key takeaways from P&G's Signal 2022 conference, featuring discussions with Group Black co-founders. The main insights covered during the conference were that the economy is not performing poorly, and TikTok is evolving beyond its initial social media categorization, indicating its broader impact on marketing and consumer engagement.

title: Unilever and InterContinental partner on sustainable hotel bathroom solutions
summary: Unilever has partnered with InterContinental Hotels Group (IHG Hotels & Resorts) to replace miniature in-bathroom amenities with bulk-sized Dove products across 80% of IHG's portfolio. This initiative, supplying hand wash, body wash, shampoo, conditioner, and body lotion, is expected to save at least 850 tonnes of plastic annually in the Americas alone. Both companies highlight their commitment to sustainable living and reducing environmental impact through this collaboration.

title: KFC Veteran George Felix Hired as Chili’s New CMO
summary: Brinker International has announced the hiring of George Felix, a veteran marketer from KFC and Pizza Hut, as the new Chief Marketing Officer for Chili’s Grill & Bar. Felix is known for his success in repositioning and revitalizing major brands, including award-winning campaigns for Old Spice, KFC, and Pizza Hut. He is expected to bring a fresh perspective and drive growth for the iconic Chili's brand.

title: How Procter & Gamble disrupted insecticides with startup brand
summary: Procter & Gamble successfully disrupted the insecticides market with its startup brand, Zevo. The article, published on July 20, 2022, highlights how P&G made inroads into this traditional sector.

title: Biggest earning US beauty and personal care companies
summary: The beauty and personal care industry saw worldwide sales rise to US$715 billion in 2021, with the US and France being the main global players. This article lists the top 15 US companies in the sector by global sales for 2021, highlighting key brands for each. Procter & Gamble leads with US$57 Billion, followed by Estée Lauder and Colgate-Palmolive.

title: P&G uses Life Cycle Assessment for Sustainable Packaging Design
summary: Procter & Gamble uses carbon-based Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs) to guide its sustainable packaging design and innovation, aiming for 100% recycled or reusable packaging by 2030 and a 50% reduction in virgin petroleum plastic. Victoria Jung, Packaging Technology Leader for P&G’s Surface Care Portfolio, highlights how this approach has led to significant plastic reductions in Swiffer and Mr. Clean products, and innovative designs for Dawn to encourage sustainable consumer behavior. The company also emphasizes continuous innovation and partnerships, such as with TerraCycle, to achieve its ambitious sustainability goals.

title: Procter & Gamble’s whittled down emerging market strategy is paying off
summary: Procter & Gamble has reported earnings of $3.03 billion for the quarter ending September 30, an increase from $2.81 billion compared to the previous year. This growth is largely attributed to its refined emerging market strategy, which has seen organic sales in developing markets increase by 8%. Unlike its rivals, P&G is focusing on a targeted approach, cutting costs, reorganizing its corporate structure, and concentrating on just 10 emerging markets with localized product strategies.

title: P&G’s Signal Summit Helps Solve Problems of Tomorrow
summary: P&G's eleventh annual #PGSignal Summit, attended by over 3,000 people, focused on learning, leading, and building in a changing world through a hybrid format. Speakers emphasized commitment, creativity, and valuing employees and consumers, with topics ranging from P&G's Water Positive Future initiative to the importance of flexibility and efficiency in business. The event highlighted how dedication, innovation, and understanding evolving societal and consumer needs are crucial for future success.

title: US: Colgate, P&G rejig price tactics to keep cash-strapped shoppers
summary: Major consumer product manufacturers like Colgate-Palmolive and Procter & Gamble are adjusting their pricing strategies to retain cash-strapped shoppers amidst recession fears. This includes targeting discounts during specific times of the month when consumers get paid and promoting premium products early in the month, then budget items later. Companies are also increasing spending on discounts, considering smaller portion sizes, and emphasizing the value of their premium national brands over cheaper alternatives to prevent consumers from switching to store brands or dollar stores.

title: P&G Leverages Digital to Drive Sales, Internal Productivity
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) is using digital technologies to enhance both its internal efficiency and its ability to attract consumers amidst challenges like supply chain disruptions and inflation. The company's CEO, Jon Moeller, highlighted the use of AI and blockchain as tools to delight consumers and customers cost-effectively. P&G's CFO, Andre Schulten, noted that over half of their advertising budget is allocated to digital channels, aligning with the growing consumer preference for eCommerce and online grocery shopping.

title: Tide maker P&G misses earnings, forecasts lower growth as consumers 'scrimp'
summary: Procter & Gamble Co (P&G) missed quarterly earnings estimates and forecast lower sales growth due to surging transportation, commodity costs, and consumer cutbacks. The company reported a resurgence of shoppers buying cheaper store brand items and noted that consumers are buying less after rounds of price hikes. P&G expects significant headwinds for fiscal 2023, including a $3.3 billion hit from a stronger dollar and higher costs.

title: Procter & Gamble, Kraft, and Nestlé Improve Recycling Practices
summary: Nestlé, Procter & Gamble, and Kraft Heinz are making significant strides in improving the recyclability of their packaging. Nestlé's Purina brand has launched mono-material pet food pouches, while P&G is introducing paper-based shampoo bars to reduce plastic use. Kraft Heinz has developed Heinz Beanz Snap Pots with 39% recycled soft plastic, highlighting a collaborative effort in the industry to achieve more sustainable packaging solutions.

title: Amid economic and stock volatility, Warren Buffett remains No. 3 investor in Kroger
summary: Legendary investor Warren Buffett maintains his position as Kroger's third-largest shareholder, holding over $3 billion in shares, despite current economic and stock market volatility. Buffett, known for his "value investing" approach, favors financially sound companies like Kroger that tend to perform steadily even during tough times. His continued investment is seen as a tacit endorsement, and Kroger's shares have shown resilience, being up double digits this year, following a significant jump after his initial investment disclosure in early 2020.

title: P&G Reduced Ad Spend In Recent Months, But Levels Are Still Above Pre-Pandemic Levels.
summary: Procter & Gamble has significantly reduced its ad spending in the last quarter due to rising inflation and supply-chain issues, although overall spending remains higher than pre-pandemic levels. Despite this reduction, P&G maintained its position as the top radio advertiser in the first half of 2022 and reported strong organic sales growth and market share gains globally. The company noted that heavy advertising is less effective in categories where supply is constrained.

title: Procter & Gamble (NYSE:PG) shareholders have earned a 12% CAGR over the last five years
summary: Procter & Gamble shareholders have seen a 12% CAGR over the last five years, largely due to dividends. While the share price alone grew 56% over five years, the total shareholder return including dividends reached 79%, outperforming the general market. The article notes that EPS growth is closely aligned with share price movement, suggesting investor sentiment has remained consistent towards the company over this period.

title: T.J. Maxx parent company to pay $13 million for selling recalled products
summary: TJX Companies Inc., the parent company of T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, and HomeGoods, has agreed to pay a $13 million fine for selling approximately 1,200 recalled products, including those that posed a suffocation risk to infants. The sales occurred between 2014 and 2019 at brick-and-mortar stores and online. TJX will also implement internal controls and file annual compliance reports for five years to prevent future sales of recalled items.

title: Procter & Gamble responds to woman's viral claim of mystery object in tampon
summary: Procter & Gamble has responded to a viral TikTok video where a user claimed to find a mysterious object inside a Tampax tampon. The company confirmed that the object was a quality control sample inadvertently given to the consumer by an employee and emphasized that it was an isolated incident. The video, which garnered over 1 million views, sparked speculation among users.

title: "We pre-vet P&G business units' readiness to collaborate with startups"
summary: Orr Hameiri, Global Tech Innovation Director at Procter & Gamble, discusses his role in connecting startups with P&G's global business units to foster innovation. He emphasizes a rigorous pre-vetting process for P&G's internal readiness, including VP approval, a budget for Proof of Concept, and dedicated human resources from the business unit, ensuring genuine commitment and successful scaling of ideas. Hameiri highlights P&G's strategic investments in startups like Grin and Moodify, focusing on partnerships that create win-win situations and impact for the five billion daily users P&G serves.

title: Colgate-Palmolive Co. stock falls Tuesday, underperforms market
summary: Colgate-Palmolive Co. (CL) shares fell 0.93% on Tuesday to $80.06, underperforming the broader market which also saw declines in the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average. The stock closed $5.55 below its 52-week high. Competitors such as Procter & Gamble Co., Unilever PLC ADR, and Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC also experienced drops in their stock prices.

title: P&G, Coca-Cola, and McCormick Develop Innovative Recycling Practices
summary: Procter & Gamble, Coca-Cola, and McCormick are implementing various innovative recycling practices to enhance sustainability. P&G is transitioning to recyclable paperboard packaging for its laundry pods, aiming to reduce plastic waste significantly. Coca-Cola is deploying reverse vending machines in the U.K. to encourage bottle return and recycling, offering incentives to consumers. McCormick is adopting 100% post-consumer recycled PET bottles for its food dyes, which will substantially decrease its carbon footprint.

title: JD.com Deepens Cooperation with Tampax
summary: JD.com and Tampax have initiated a workshop to deepen their cooperation, aiming for a tenfold growth in Tampax's transaction volume on JD.com within five years. Despite China's tampon market being in its early stages with only a 2% user penetration, the companies plan joint marketing campaigns to increase product exposure, consumer education, and brand awareness, especially among Gen Z and student populations. This collaboration seeks to capitalize on the growing health-conscious lifestyle and increased sports participation among women in China.

title: Major lease in hand, Granite kicks off Brantford biz park
summary: Granite REIT is developing the 1.7-million-square-foot Telephone City Logistics Centre in Brantford, with global chocolate maker Barry Callebaut as the first major tenant. Barry Callebaut will invest over $130 million in a 409,000-square-foot specialty chocolate production facility, which is expected to create 200 jobs by Q1 2024. This development highlights Brantford's strategic location and value proposition for industrial users, attracting significant interest and investment in the region.

title: The Latest Innovations from Procter & Gamble
summary: Procter & Gamble is showcasing its latest innovations in dish care, fabric care, and hair care, emphasizing water-saving attributes and sustainable packaging. The company highlights products like Dawn Powerwash for reduced water usage, Pantene Perfec+ On No Rinse Conditioner, and the Ecoclic Box for Ariel Pods, which is fully recyclable and designed for improved accessibility. These innovations reflect P&G's commitment to environmental impact reduction and consumer-focused design.

title: Superiority to Win with Consumers
summary: Procter & Gamble emphasizes its commitment to "superiority" across product, packaging, brand communication, retail execution, and value to win with consumers, especially amid inflation. The company leverages this approach to grow market share and adapt to evolving consumer needs, such as sustainability and value for money. Examples like Dawn EZ-Squeeze, Olay Regenerist, plastic-free Gillette packaging, and the "Time to Tampax" campaign illustrate how P&G drives sales growth and strengthens brand loyalty through innovation and effective strategies.

title: Data Wrangling: How Procter and Gamble Maximizes Business Analytics
summary: This article details how Procter & Gamble, under the leadership of CIO Filippo Passerini, transformed its business analytics capabilities through the development of "Decision Cockpits" and the "Business Sphere." These tools enable real-time decision-making, eliminate data debate, and provide a unified view of business status by integrating vast amounts of data points. P&G aims to continue investing in BI and business analysts to maintain its competitive advantage and operate in real time.

title: Mars Petcare Strengthens R&D Leadership With Alex Cedeno Hire
summary: Mars Petcare has appointed Alejandro (Alex) Cedeno as Senior Vice President of Research & Development for its North America operations. In this role, Cedeno will oversee R&D across various critical areas, including quality, food safety, innovation, and sustainability, while also driving global R&D strategies. Cedeno joins with 28 years of experience in the CPG industry, including leadership positions at J.M. Smucker Company and Procter & Gamble.

title: Coty Inc. Cl A stock underperforms Tuesday when compared to competitors
summary: Coty Inc. Class A stock (COTY) declined by 1.26% on Tuesday, closing at $7.81, amidst a general market downturn where both the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average also fell. This marked its third consecutive day of losses and left the stock $3.31 below its 52-week high. Despite the dip, its performance was mixed relative to competitors, with some falling more and others less.

title: P&G CEO Jon Moeller: 'We will always try to couple both price increases with innovation'
summary: Procter & Gamble CEO Jon Moeller discusses the company's strategy amid high inflation, supply chain issues, and the war in Ukraine. Moeller emphasizes coupling price increases with innovation and highlights the company's various price offerings to retain customers. He also addresses P&G's continued, though reduced, business operations in Russia and his personal feelings about the conflict.

title: P&G Is the Latest Brand Supporting Alternative Identifier UID2
summary: Procter & Gamble, a major advertiser, has announced its support for UID2, an alternative identifier developed by The Trade Desk. This move enables P&G to leverage its first-party data for privacy-compliant targeting on publishers' sites supporting UID2. This is significant for a CPG brand like P&G, which traditionally has fewer direct customer touchpoints, and follows prior Trade Desk partnerships with retailers.

title: Real Deals: Procter & Gamble-leased building in Fayetteville sells for $12.7 million
summary: A 61,017-square-foot office building in Fayetteville, triple-net leased to Procter & Gamble Distributing LLC, recently sold for $12.7 million. This transaction highlights a growing real estate market, with other significant sales including a $2.25 million commercial building in Fort Smith and a $1.3 million industrial/warehouse building in Siloam Springs. The deals showcase various commercial property acquisitions and developments across Arkansas.

title: Procter & Gamble Is Doing The Unified ID 2.0 Thing
summary: Procter & Gamble publicly announced its support for Unified ID 2.0, an open-source initiative led by The Trade Desk aiming to replace third-party cookies with hashed, encrypted email-based identifiers. P&G has already been using UID 2.0 since last year for activating anonymized identifiers linked to its first-party data in the bidstream. Attracting marketers like P&G is crucial for UID2's success, although scaling the initiative and finding an administrator remain ongoing challenges.

title: P&G Design Brings Creative Spark to Cincinnati Festival
summary: P&G Design served as the official Creative Sponsor for the BLINK Parade in Cincinnati, Ohio, showcasing their talent and design prowess. The team contributed to the city's artistic culture by illuminating the history and heritage of P&G through various art installations and the Future City Light Spectacular BLINK Parade. This initiative highlights P&G's dual role as a "Force for Growth" and a "Force for Good" in its hometown.

title: Bed, Bath & Beyond CFO Gustavo Arnal dies after falling from NYC skyscraper
summary: Bed, Bath & Beyond CFO Gustavo Arnal died after falling from a Manhattan building. Police responded to reports of an unconscious person and found the 52-year-old unresponsive near the "Jenga building." The company expressed profound sadness, remembering Arnal for his leadership and talent, just days after Bed Bath & Beyond announced store closures and layoffs as part of a turnaround strategy.

title: Bed Bath & Beyond CFO Gustavo Arnal faced $1.2B lawsuit before suicide
summary: Gustavo Arnal, the CFO of Bed Bath & Beyond, died by suicide shortly after being named in a $1.2 billion class-action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleged Arnal was involved in a "pump and dump" scheme to artificially inflate the company's stock. His death occurred as Bed Bath & Beyond announced store closures and layoffs to address its financial struggles.

title: Kroger and P&G Come Together to Uplift Women in Business and Honor Female Scholars Ahead of the Kroger Queen City Championship Presented by P&G
summary: Kroger and P&G announced the inaugural class of their women's leadership program, the Queen City Game Changers, and awarded five female scholars with the first-ever Game Changers Scholarship. This initiative aims to accelerate the advancement of women in sports, business, and education, fostering the next generation of female leaders within the Queen City community. The program includes a world-class curriculum, mentorship, and support for multicultural women pursuing advanced degrees.

title: Gustavo Arnal: Retail exec spent 20-plus years at P&G before his death by suicide
summary: Gustavo Arnal, the Bed Bath & Beyond executive who died by suicide, had a long career with Procter & Gamble Co. from 1993 to 2017, holding various executive finance roles globally. Before joining Bed Bath & Beyond as CFO, he also worked at Walgreens Boots Alliance and Avon. At the time of his death, Arnal was involved in legal issues, including a class-action lawsuit, and Bed Bath & Beyond was undergoing significant restructuring.

title: 'A huge win': Consumer products giant plans $180M expansion in north St. Louis
summary: Procter & Gamble plans a $180 million expansion of its factory in north St. Louis. This development is seen as a significant win for St. Louis, contributing to urban revitalization, job creation, and training opportunities. A development official highlighted the competitive nature of securing this expansion and its role in transforming the riverfront.

title: 'A huge win': Consumer products giant plans $180M expansion in north St. Louis
summary: Procter & Gamble Manufacturing Co. (NYSE: PG) is planning a $180 million expansion of its existing 17-acre campus in north St. Louis, supported by state and local subsidies. The project involves $120 million in property improvements and $60 million in new equipment, aiming to retain 530 existing jobs and create 100 new ones with an average annual wage of $65,000. St. Louis successfully competed to secure this expansion.

title: Global Tampon Market Size to Hit US$ 6044.87 Million by 2028, With 5.90% CAGR: Comprehensive Research Report by Facts & Factors
summary: The global Tampon Market is projected to reach US$ 6044.87 million by 2028, growing at a CAGR of 5.90% from an estimated US$ 4285.60 million in 2021. This growth is driven by increasing awareness of female hygiene and consumer demand for convenient products. The report highlights organic tampons, unscented varieties, and online retail as dominant segments, with North America leading the market regionally.

title: Why Procter & Gamble says it chose north St. Louis for $180M expansion
summary: Procter & Gamble is expanding its St. Louis facility with a $180 million investment, driven by a local jobs program and incentives. While tax incentives played a role, the plant manager highlighted an additional key factor in the company's decision. This expansion underscores the importance of local support in attracting corporate investment.

title: The Best Beauty Looks Of The 2022 Emmys
summary: This article showcases the best hair and makeup looks from the 74th Primetime Emmy Awards red carpet in 2022. It highlights various celebrities, detailing their hair and makeup artists and the products they used. The piece emphasizes the importance of red carpet glamour as a spectacle alongside the awards themselves.

title: Johnson & Johnson and a New War on Consumer Protection
summary: This article details Johnson & Johnson's legal battles regarding allegations that its talcum powder caused cancer in consumers. It highlights the company's controversial "Texas two-step" bankruptcy strategy to manage tens of thousands of lawsuits and discusses the broader implications for consumer protection laws and corporate accountability.

title: P&G launches Downy Rinse & Refresh
summary: Procter & Gamble has introduced Downy Rinse & Refresh, a new product aimed at tackling odors. Company officials are touting this as one of the brand's most significant innovations in over three decades. The launch was reported by the Cincinnati Business Courier.

title: US Plastics Pact activators see federal policy as key to achieving 2025 packaging reduction goals
summary: Members of the U.S. Plastics Pact, including Mars and Keurig Dr Pepper, are calling for "harmonized" federal legislation and government support to help achieve their 2025 goals of making all plastic packaging reusable, recyclable, or compostable. They aim to incorporate at least 30% recycled or bio-based content and reduce virgin plastic use, but face challenges from market conditions and the need for improved recycling infrastructure. Federal policy changes, such as updated "Green Guides" and national EPR programs, are seen as crucial to accelerating progress and creating a more consistent approach to plastic waste management.

title: National Advertising Review Board Recommends P&G Discontinue Odor Elimination Claims for Febreze Products
summary: The National Advertising Review Board (NARB) has recommended that Procter & Gamble (P&G) stop using "odor elimination" claims for its Febreze products. The NARB concluded that P&G's testing methodology did not sufficiently prove actual odor elimination, but rather only odor reduction. P&G expressed disagreement with the decision but committed to complying with the recommendations.

title: Defensive Characteristics Help Procter & Gamble Stand Apart
summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) is highlighted as a strong, reliable investment due to its defensive characteristics, consistent dividend payments for 66 consecutive years, and diversified portfolio of essential consumer goods. Despite macroeconomic headwinds like inflation and supply chain issues, the company has maintained strong financial performance and is considered recession-resistant, making it a safe choice for long-term shareholders. The article emphasizes its ability to navigate challenging market conditions due to its established operating model and the necessity of its products.

title: Environmental groups ask P&G investors to vote against CEO as board chair
summary: Environmental groups are urging Procter & Gamble Co (PG.N) investors to vote against re-electing CEO Jon Moeller as board chair and two other directors, Angela Braly and Patricia Woertz, at the upcoming annual meeting. This opposition stems from claims that P&G uses excessive virgin wood pulp in its paper products and has not adequately addressed deforestation in its supply chains. The groups are advocating for an independent board chair and criticizing the company's efforts on sustainability, particularly regarding sourcing palm oil and wood pulp.

title: P&G Announces its Largest Solar Energy Deal to Date with Engie
summary: Procter and Gamble (P&G) has announced its largest solar energy agreement to date, a 200 MW Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with ENGIE for their Sun Valley Renewable Energy Project in Hill County, Texas. This deal is expected to provide over 530,000 MWh of renewable power annually, displacing more than 367,000 metric tons of CO2-equivalent, and is a key step towards P&G's net-zero by 2040 target. ENGIE's Sun Valley Solar project contributes to its broader strategy of major investments in renewable energy across North America.

title: PVH Corp. Appoints Sara Bland as Chief Strategy Officer
summary: PVH Corp. announced the appointment of Sara Bland as Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, effective October 31. Bland, formerly EVP of Global Strategy at Kontoor Brands, will join PVH's Executive Leadership Team and report to CEO Stefan Larsson. She will be instrumental in driving the company's multiyear PVH+ Plan to maximize the potential of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger and foster long-term growth.

title: Unilever CEO Jope To Retire At End Of 2023 After GSK Setback
summary: Unilever CEO Alan Jope announced his retirement at the end of 2023, following a turbulent period for the company which included a failed bid for GSK's consumer health unit and criticism from investors regarding lackluster growth and a focus on "purpose" over profits. His departure gives Unilever time to find a successor while facing challenges like inflation, supply chain issues, and a declining pound, and comes after an activist investor gained a board seat.

title: Procter & Gamble Hair Care Brands Gold Series by Pantene and Royal Oils by Head & Shoulders Announce Awardees of $1 Million #RootedinScience Scholarship
summary: Procter & Gamble's haircare brands, Gold Series from Pantene and Royal Oils by Head & Shoulders, have announced the 31 recipients of their second annual Rooted in Science Scholarship. This initiative, in partnership with UNCF, awards scholarships to Black students pursuing STEM degrees at HBCUs and UNCF-member schools, aiming to address the underrepresentation of Black professionals in STEM. In total, the brands have committed $1 million towards these scholarships to support future Black STEM innovators.

title: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. stock rises Wednesday, still underperforms market
summary: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) stock saw a 1.35% increase on Wednesday, closing at $95.27, breaking a six-day losing streak, despite the broader market also rising significantly. The stock remains $59.73 below its 52-week high and displayed mixed performance against competitors like L'Oreal S.A. ADR and Estee Lauder Cos. Cl A, while Procter & Gamble Co. remained unchanged. Trading volume for IFF exceeded its 50-day average.

title: J&J says new Band-Aid and Tylenol company to be named Kenvue | Company Business News
summary: Johnson & Johnson announced that its new consumer-health products company, which will house brands like Band-Aid and Tylenol, will be named Kenvue. This separation of the consumer unit, with $15 billion in annual revenue, from J&J's prescription-drug and medical-device business, is expected to be completed next year. Kenvue is a portmanteau of "ken" (knowledge) and "vue" (sight), signifying its focus on consumer insights and health solutions.

title: Band-Aids and Tylenol will have a new name on their packages
summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) is splitting its business into two companies, with its consumer health brands like Band-Aid and Tylenol falling under a new corporate parent named Kenvue. The new name, a combination of "Ken" and "vue," was chosen to be distinctive, memorable, and clear of trademark issues across many languages, reflecting a strategy where the corporate identity takes a backseat to its well-known product brands. The split is expected to be completed next year.

title: P&G turns to AI to create digital manufacturing of the future
summary: P&G has partnered with Microsoft to transform its manufacturing operations using AI, IoT, and digital twin technology. This initiative aims to enhance product quality, optimize equipment resiliency, and improve sustainability across its global manufacturing sites. The company is scaling these smart manufacturing solutions to accelerate innovation, increase productivity, and reduce costs in its consumer goods production.

title: Procter & Gamble submit to develop non-wood fibre products
summary: Procter & Gamble is increasing its use of alternative fibers in its products due to environmentalist pressure, committing to using bamboo fiber for its Charmin Ultra Eco toilet paper and investing over US$20mn+ over five years to develop non-wood fiber alternatives. The company also announced a commitment to using recycled fiber in its cardboard and packaging, aiming for 100% recycled fiber in packaging by 2025. These moves come after criticism regarding the environmental impact of wood-based products, particularly on the Canadian boreal forest.

title: From Virtual Interns to Full-Time Employees
summary: This article highlights how Procter & Gamble successfully transitioned virtual interns, such as Myles Whitmore and Vishnu Paranandi, into full-time employees during and after the pandemic. It details P&G's strategies for fostering connectedness and camaraderie among new hires in a hybrid work environment, including "Power Pairs" and enhanced onboarding. The experience also led P&G to embrace greater flexibility in its work models, recognizing that not all tasks require in-person presence.

title: Procter & Gamble founders' descendants among protesters at company headquarters
summary: Descendants of Procter & Gamble's founders protested outside the company's Cincinnati headquarters, claiming P&G was involved in human rights violations, climate inaction, and deforestation. The protest, organized by the Rainforest Action Network, saw two individuals arrested after climbing flagpoles. P&G responded by stating they value shareholder viewpoints and aim to keep forests intact, regrowing two trees for every one used.

title: P&G CEO and chairman, corporate directors re-elected to board after challenge
summary: Procter & Gamble Co shareholders re-elected their CEO, chairman, and current directors despite challenges from environmental non-profits regarding deforestation actions. Shareholders also approved executive compensation, which this year included ESG goal performance as a factor. The CEO addressed concerns about consumers switching to cheaper private-label goods due to inflation, highlighting product value and longevity.

title: Procter & Gamble Ups Marketing to Persuade Consumers on Pricier Products
summary: Despite inflation, Procter & Gamble is increasing its marketing efforts to convince consumers to continue purchasing its more expensive, premium products. The company is using celebrity ad campaigns and introducing new product features to maintain brand loyalty and prevent shoppers from switching to cheaper alternatives. P&G is betting that these strategies will help them overcome the financial pressures consumers are facing.

title: The Price of Procter & Gamble’s Inaction
summary: Rainforest Action Network (RAN) protested Procter & Gamble's inaction on deforestation and human rights abuses in its supply chain, joined by descendants of P&G's founders and supported by major institutional investors. The article details P&G's continued sourcing from problematic suppliers linked to land grabs and illegal deforestation, despite shareholder pressure and internal commitments. It highlights the environmental harm and human suffering caused by P&G's pulp and palm oil sourcing, especially in Indonesia and the Canadian boreal.

title: V3 Ventures launches to put €100M into startups in health, beauty and food
summary: V3 Ventures, an independent venture fund backed by Verlinvest, has launched with a €100 million initiative to invest directly in consumer-focused startups. The fund plans to target pre-seed to Series A investments in e-commerce, health and beauty, and food and beverage sectors across the U.K., Europe, U.S., and India. Co-founded by Lopo Champalimaud, V3 Ventures emphasizes an ESG focus and leverages Verlinvest's international network, having already invested in several startups.

title: Consumer Giants Keep Raising Prices as Profits Come Under Pressure (Published 2022)
summary: Nestlé and Procter & Gamble continued to raise prices last quarter, generating higher sales despite lower sales volumes as consumers face inflation. Both companies expect price increases to continue to offset rising costs and restore profit margins. This trend highlights how consumer giants are navigating inflation, impacting shoppers and posing a challenge for central banks.

title: Procter & Gamble (PG) Stock Gains 2% on Earnings Beat
summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) stock saw a 2% gain on Wednesday following an earnings beat for its fiscal first quarter, surpassing analyst expectations for both earnings and sales. Despite the positive financial results driven by price increases, the company issued a guidance downgrade for its fiscal year earnings due to currency effects and higher material costs, raising concerns about longer-term pricing sustainability and consumer affordability. The article highlights that while price hikes have helped mitigate expenses, they are also leading to a decline in sales volume and potential challenges as consumers tighten budgets.

title: Procter & Gamble trims ad spending again, but still beats forecasts
summary: Procter & Gamble has once again reduced its ad spending but still managed to surpass its financial forecasts. This indicates a continued trend for the consumer goods giant to optimize its advertising expenditures while maintaining strong business performance.

title: Women Boycott Ulta Beauty for Promoting ‘Trans’ Activists Explaining ‘Girlhood’ – But Are There Any Cosmetic Companies That Aren’t Woke?
summary: Ulta Beauty faced a boycott after promoting a video featuring a "gender fluid" host and a "transgender" activist discussing "girlhood." This controversy led many to question if any major cosmetic companies exist that haven't embraced "transgenderism." The article then examines the top ten cosmetic firms globally, finding that most have actively promoted gender ideology through their marketing and hiring practices, with Kao being a potential exception.

title: What you should know about the cancer-causing chemical found in recalled dry shampoo
summary: Health Canada has issued a mass recall of hair products, specifically dry shampoos, due to the detection of benzene, a known cancer-causing chemical. This article serves as an explainer to inform consumers about the implications of this recall and the risks associated with benzene exposure in these products.

title: P&G Cuts Back On Ad Spending, Again.
summary: Procter & Gamble has reduced its advertising spending for the second consecutive quarter due to rising costs, though executives maintain that marketing effectiveness has not diminished. The company has shifted more ad dollars to digital and in-house digital buying, improving efficiency. Despite a decline in total ad spending, P&G's fiscal first-quarter results surpassed analyst expectations, driven by a 7% rise in organic sales.

title: Milliken, PureCycle launch concentrate made with recycled PP resin
summary: Milliken & Co. and PureCycle Technologies have partnered to create the first fully sustainable concentrate for polypropylene (PP) made with recycled resin, offering a carbon footprint approximately 35 percent lower than virgin PP. This odorless, color-free concentrate expands the use of 100 percent recycled content in injection-molded parts and utilizes Milliken's Millad NX 8000 ECO clarifier for certified energy savings. PureCycle's CEO Dustin Olson highlights the concentrate's advantage of not requiring operational adjustments for customers, unlike other recycled materials.

title: A Road Less Traveled
summary: This article details the inspiring journey of Raymond Lynch, a P&G Global Ambassador for Employees with Disabilities and Medical Conditions. After a life-altering accident, Raymond advocated for greater disability inclusion within P&G, leading to the creation of support groups and training programs for employees with disabilities. His efforts have significantly advanced P&G's commitment to fostering a disability-confident culture and ensuring accessibility for all employees.

title: Coca-Cola raises full-year outlook as earnings beat expectations
summary: Coca-Cola (KO) raised its full-year outlook for adjusted earnings per share and organic revenue growth after beating Wall Street's expectations for its third-quarter earnings. The company's organic revenue grew 16%, driven by price hikes, while unit case volume rose 4%. Coca-Cola expects commodity prices to remain volatile and anticipates further price hikes and challenges from foreign currency in 2023, while also focusing on offering more affordable options to consumers.

title: Church & Dwight Co. stock rises Tuesday, outperforms market
summary: Shares of Church & Dwight Co. (CHD) increased by 1.95% on Tuesday, closing at $75.62, outperforming the broader market which also saw gains with the S&P 500 rising 1.63% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average up 1.07%. This marked the third consecutive day of gains for the stock. Church & Dwight Co. closed significantly below its 52-week high and outperformed several competitors on the day.

title: Unilever recalls Dove, Tresemmé, other dry shampoos over cancer risk
summary: Unilever has recalled several popular aerosol dry shampoo brands, including Dove, Nexxus, Suave, Tresemmé, and Tigi, due to contamination with benzene, a chemical known to cause cancer. The recall applies to products manufactured before October 2021 and highlights ongoing concerns about the safety of aerosols in personal-care products. The benzene contamination is believed to stem from the propellants used in these products.

title: Meta's $677 Billion Rout Boots It Out Of World's Top 20 Stocks
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. has seen its market value collapse by $677 billion this year, largely due to its significant investments in the metaverse, pushing it out of the world's top 20 largest companies. The stock correction continues to worsen as investors react negatively to ballooning costs and a decline in revenue outlook. Analysts are also cutting ratings, indicating that the company's aggressive long-term metaverse investments are a concern despite revenue growth deceleration.

title: Flows Into Consumer Staples ETFs Rebound on Economic Uncertainty
summary: Investors are increasingly moving back into consumer staples ETFs, a defensive strategy during economic uncertainty. The Invesco S&P 500® Equal Weight Consumer Staples ETF (RHS) has seen significant net inflows, indicating a preference for equal-weighted approaches to mitigate company-specific risks that are common in market-cap weighted funds dominated by a few large companies. This shift reflects advisors' search for downside protection while still participating in market upside in the current economic climate.

title: Procter & Gamble brands aim to end dental inequities by 2030
summary: P&G's Crest and Oral-B brands have set a goal to eliminate dental inequities by 2030. This initiative aims to address disparities in oral health care access and outcomes. The announcement was made on November 01, 2022, as part of their broader commitment to social responsibility.

title: P&G, Colgate, Church & Dwight Named EPA 2022 Safer Choice Partners of the Year
summary: The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) announced P&G, Colgate, and Church & Dwight, among others, as 2022 Safer Choice Partner of the Year award winners.
